summary: Futurewave Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its IPO on June 26, 2026. The IPO consisted of 8,625,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the over-allotment option, for total gross proceeds of $86.25 million. Each unit comprises one ordinary share, one right to receive one-fourth of a share upon a future business combination, and one warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. Polaris Advisory Partners acted as sole book-running manager. This is a standard SPAC IPO closing, not a special situation. The filing includes routine agreements such as the underwriting, rights, and warrant agreements.
